quests.name: Telvanni Research
quests.canDoWhy: Neloth offers it as one of his research jobs when you talk to him in Tel Mithryn.

starts.where: inside Neloth's tower at Tel Mithryn, on Solstheim
starts.how: Talk to Neloth; he wants a sample of ash from an ash spawn, taken with a special extraction tool.

quests.firstStep: Collect ash from an ash spawn with the extraction tool

takesYou.place: wherever you find an ash spawn

objectives: Collect ash from an ash spawn

rewards.when: listed on the quest's script; the files don't say when it is given

people.name: Neloth
people.role: gives the task and takes it back; stays in his tower at Tel Mithryn

unsure.why: The game offers Neloth's research jobs through one shared trigger that fires when you change location; that trigger's own conditions aren't in these files, so what you must have done first (and the order the jobs come in) isn't known here.
The quest names no particular ash spawn or place; any ash spawn seems to do. Solstheim is assumed because the quest giver and the rest of the job are there.
The Extraction Perk is probably what lets you use the tool on an ash spawn rather than a lasting reward; the records only give its name.

evidence: NPC Dragonborn.esm:01773A, ref 0177DA in cell 017787; package DLC2NelothSandbox
